Interface IuOidcProviderConfiguration

public interface IuOidcProviderConfiguration
Describes the OpenID Connect provider itself.

Only what is true of the provider as a whole lives here. Each relying party registered with it is described separately, by IuOidcClientConfiguration.

Property names use lower case with underscores, so getAuthorizationCodeTimeToLive() reads authorization_code_time_to_live.

  • Method Details

    • getMetadata

      edu.iu.oidc.IuOidcProviderMetadata getMetadata()
      Gets the discovery metadata this provider publishes, and reads its own endpoint URIs back out of.

      The document is published verbatim, so it is both what a relying party discovers and what the provider honors: the issuer it advertises is the base URI every one of this provider's own endpoints is built from. Advertising an issuer the deployment isn't reachable at breaks authentication, not just discovery.

      Returns:
      IuOidcProviderMetadata

    • getJwks

      Iterable<edu.iu.crypt.WebKey> getJwks()
      Gets the provider's own keys, which sign what it issues.

      A key's alg is what selects it: the provider picks a signing key by algorithm, and the signature algorithms the discovery document advertises are derived from these keys, so nothing is published that no key can sign with. Keys are listed in preference order — the first signing key is the one used when no particular algorithm is called for.

      Returns:
      issuer keys

    • getAuthorizationCodeTimeToLive

      default Duration getAuthorizationCodeTimeToLive()
      Gets how long an issued authorization code remains redeemable.
      Returns:
      Duration; one minute by default, the longest OAuth 2.0 recommends

    • getAccessTokenTimeToLive

      default Duration getAccessTokenTimeToLive()
      Gets how long an issued access token remains valid.

      A resource server bounds this independently — it may refuse a bearer token whose iat to exp span exceeds what the resource allows — so a value longer than the resource permits yields a token that verifies here and is refused there.

      Returns:
      Duration; fifteen minutes by default

    • getRefreshTokenTimeToLive

      default Duration getRefreshTokenTimeToLive()
      Gets how long an issued refresh token remains redeemable.

      This bounds how long a client can keep obtaining access tokens without the end user returning to the identity provider, so it should not outlast the authentication it descends from.

      Returns:
      Duration; twelve hours by default
